description.value:
Given materials, a surface, and a few uninterrupted minutes, there is not much you cannot produce. Your work does not fail, does not require a workshop, and does not much care whether you had the correct components to begin with.

1st Level

  • You gain the Alchemical Crafting, Magical Crafting, and Snare Crafting skill feats.
  • You may Craft any item whose level is no greater than your level + 2.
  • Each level, you learn formulas equal to your Crafting proficiency rank: 2 Trained, 4 Expert, 6 Master, 8 Legendary.

5th Level

  • When you would succeed at a Crafting check, you critically succeed instead.
  • You may Craft without a workshop, using only what you carry.
  • You may substitute any raw materials for any others of equal or greater value.
  • Crafting an item takes 1 day and costs 75% of the item's Price.
    • This cost is fixed and cannot be reduced by spending additional time.

10th Level

  • You may Craft during a 10-minute rest.
  • Salvaging an item recovers 75% of its value in materials rather than half.
  • You may transfer or swap runes during a 10-minute rest at no cost, regardless of the rune's level or your proficiency rank.

15th Level

  • Gain Reforging.
    • Reforging Once per day, during a 10-minute rest, convert any item into any other item of equal or lower level that you know the formula for, at no cost. The original item is consumed.
    • This includes runes, letting you convert one rune directly into another.

In Foundry: the three skill feats are granted, a Crafting success is a critical success from 5th, and Reforging is on your Actions tab from 15th with its daily use counted.

For the table: the crafting economy. The level + 2 cap, formulas learned per level, crafting without a workshop, material substitution, the 1-day time and 75% cost, salvage at 75%, and free rune transfers are all applied when you craft; PF2e's crafting has no rule element for any of them. A note on Crafting checks lists them.
